answer:
Your most recent A1c was 6.9%, drawn on 16 Feb 2026. That is in the range usually aimed for in diabetes (under about 7% for many adults), and it is the lowest value since your 6.7% in Jan 2024.

For context, your earlier results were 7.6% (May 2025) and 7.1% (Aug 2025), after a peak of 8.3% in Jan 2025. So the trend has been steadily downward since Jardiance was started in Feb 2025.

That result is now more than 8 months old, and I see no newer one in your records. A recheck is due, so it's worth asking for one at your check-up. If you've had one elsewhere, bring the result.
